description: This file defines the GeoZone controller class for the OpenCart admin module, responsible for managing geographical zones, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting them within the admin interface.

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: Controller class handling CRUD operations and interface rendering for Geo Zones in OpenCart's admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that sets up the page, loads necessary language, and renders the Geo Zone list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Calls getList to generate and output the list view of geo zones.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches geo zones from the model with applied sorting, pagination, and builds the data array for the view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a Geo Zone, populating data if editing an existing entry.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving new or updated Geo Zone data, with validation and permission checks, returning JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected Geo Zones after permission check and confirming no related tax rates, returning JSON response.
